fields.name: clk_mode
fields.doc: 0: fabric clock enable = one pulse per TCK rising edge while USER1 ce (JTAG-stepped); 1: free-running divider

fields.name: clk_div
fields.doc: free-running: enable every 2**(clk_div+10) sysclk cycles (when clk_period is 0)

fields.name: reserved
fields.doc: write 0

fields.name: clk_period
fields.doc: M20 free-running: enable every clk_period x 2**clk_div sysclk cycles; 0 = every 2**(clk_div+DIV_MIN_SHIFT)

fields.name: clk_gap
fields.doc: M20: this design's minimum gce spacing in sysclk cycles, from its critical path (never below 2); 0 = the safe 2**10

fields.name: e0.init
fields.doc: element 0: LUT6 truth table; O5 = INIT[31:0] over i[4:0]

fields.name: e0.frac
fields.doc: two LUT(K-1)s: input K-1 reads 1, so O6 = INIT[2**K-1:2**(K-1)] and O5 = INIT[2**(K-1)-1:0], both over i[K-2:0]

fields.name: e0.ff_en
fields.doc: out[0] = FF q (1) or combinational (0)

fields.name: e0.ff_rstval
fields.doc: INIT and sync reset value: FDRE=0 / FDSE=1

fields.name: e0.ff_ce_en
fields.doc: 1: FF honours the CLB's routed CE, 0: always enabled

fields.name: e0.ff_sr_en
fields.doc: 1: FF honours the CLB's routed SR, 0: reset ignored

fields.name: e0.cy_en
fields.doc: carry mode: XORCY sum on out[0]'s datapath, MUXCY cout

fields.name: e0.cy_di_sel
fields.doc: carry generate: 0 = i[0], 1 = O5

fields.name: e0.ff_d_sel
fields.doc: out[0] datapath: 0 = O6, 1 = O5 (ignored if cy_en)

fields.name: e0.ff2_en
fields.doc: out[1] = second FF q (1) or O5 (0)

fields.name: e0.ff2_rstval
fields.doc: second FF: INIT and sync reset value

fields.name: e0.ff2_ce_en
fields.doc: second FF honours the routed CE

fields.name: e0.ff2_sr_en
fields.doc: second FF honours the routed SR

fields.doc: element 0 input 0: 0 const0, 1 const1, 2.. crossbar source (xbar_sources)

rr.doc: nodes: [id, type, xlow, ylow, xhigh, yhigh, ptc, direction]; muxes: [node, chain_lo, width, base, [input nodes]] - value base+i selects input i, 0 const0, 1 const1 (IPIN only); directs: [ipin, opin]

chain.order: frames end to end (M13): FAR column 0 = ctrl tile, FAR column x+1 = grid column x with tiles bottom to top (the fields of the block rooted there, then its routing muxes by rr node id), each column padded to whole frames
chain.bit_order: chain bit k is the k-th bit shifted in on TDI (LSB-first)

frames.far: [25:23] block type (000 config), [22] top/bottom, [21:17] row, [16:7] column, [6:0] minor
frames.doc: frame f = chain bits [128f+127:128f]; word w bit k = frame bit 32w+k

bsr.cells: cell k (bit k, cell 0 nearest TDO): k < NPAD output cell of pad k (fabric -> world, GTS-gated), k >= NPAD input cell of pad k-NPAD (world -> fabric)

cluster.doc: CLB = n elements; element e's fields are e<e>.* at chain_lo + e * element_width; its input j is node EIN driven by the crossbar mux e<e>.x<j> (0 const0, 1 const1, 2+i xbar_sources[e][j][i]); its outputs are the CLB's O[2e] (out[0]) and O[2e+1] (out[1])

bram.drive: 64 bits per BRAM: port A pins [31:0] (addr, di, we, en, rst, regce), port B [63:32]

dsp.cascade: dsp1.pcin <- dsp0.pcout (= P), a VPR direct; dsp0.pcin = 0
